note.zh: 情境销毁；解锁心灵传统；“荫蔽锻造”起源改与黏土动画师接触并触发 2810。
note.en: The situation ends, psionic traditions unlock; Shroud-Forged empires open contact with the Animator of Clay (2810).

notes.zh: 审阅注：情境从 shroud.2750 开始（initial_progress 0；阶段一结束 500，阶段二 750，阶段三结束 1000）；每月检查 shroud.2200：阶段一进度≥150 发一次社会事件；进度达 325/625/875 各发一次三类池事件；进入阶段二 → 2760，阶段三 → 2780，进度满 → 2800。
notes.en: Review note: the situation starts from shroud.2750 (progress 0; stage 1 ends at 500, stage 2 at 750, stage 3 at 1000). shroud.2200 runs monthly: one social event after progress 150 in stage 1; one pool event at 325 / 625 / 875; entering stage 2 fires 2760, stage 3 fires 2780, completion fires 2800.

notes.zh: 审阅注：2750 由传统“进入荫蔽”(tr_psionics_shroud_adopt)启用时触发（深渊吞噬者起源改发 shroud.8310）；立即调用 mind_over_matter_immediate 并开始情境。
notes.en: Review note: 2750 is fired when the psionics tradition is enabled (the Endbringers origin gets shroud.8310 instead) and starts the situation.

scope.zh: 突破荫蔽（心灵升华）情境：入口、情境、阶段事件、结局及全部4个随机事件池（28个事件）。
scope.en: Breach the Shroud (psionic ascension): entry, situation, stage events, ending and all four random event pools (28 events).

uncertain: 2760、2780 的完整效果（心灵军团建筑、全面觉醒传统）只读取了正文与选项提示，未逐项展开；utopia.2602/2652 来自乌托邦篇。 / The full effects of 2760 and 2780 and the utopia events were only skimmed.
